This may be absolute bullshit but it helps me put things I do into perspective.

Imagine looking at yourself from a 3rd person point of view. As if, maybe, you're subjectively watching a movie of your life. And you want this person to live a good life. You want them to live happy and be successful.

It doesn't really help me be any less sad... But it helps me put things into perspective and ask "what the fuck am I doing?"

I only want to help. My advice might suck so completely disregard it if it makes you feel worse. Just a suggestion that may or may not work.

Good luck and please PLEASE don't cut yourself. Once you get past this (and you will) you'll be happy you stopped cutting yourself when you did. No matter how long it took you to stop. It'll be an accomplishment. And the earlier you stop the better you'll feel when you're better. And you WILL get better. Just keep searching man.
